title: README: group CLI overview for readability
description:
From the docs/UX review round: README documents commands in 9 flat Quick-Start sections, but the CLI exposes 17 subcommands (init new list show status approve update delete link unlink review epic next convert tui summary flow) and 6 of them are absent from README entirely (epic next convert summary + experimental tui flow). Question: restructure the command guide for readability, e.g. group into 'Flat issues' (new/list/show/update/status/approve/delete), 'Project management' (epic/next/link/unlink/convert), 'Other views' (review/summary/tui/flow). Decide grouping + which experimental commands get documented, then update README (and cross-check --help grouping stays coherent).

Decision (owner 2026-09-24): group as suggested - 'Flat issues' (new/list/show/update/status/approve/delete), 'Project management' (epic/next/link/unlink/convert), 'Other views' (review/summary/tui/flow). Document flow+tui as experimental. Cross-check --help grouping stays coherent.
